cellulose.text: Reinforcement matrix improving tensile strength and impact resistance. Asbestos-free formulation.

silica.title: Silica aggregate
silica.text: Filler contributing to density, compressive strength, and surface hardness of the finished board.

autoclaved.title: Autoclaved curing

applications.title: Cement board applications for walls, facades, and wet rooms

facade-systems.title: Lightweight cement board for facade systems
facade-systems.text: Specified as a facade cement board and cement board for exterior walls in CBSS and CBMV ventilated facade systems across European climate zones. This lightweight facade panel provides exterior wall sheathing as an exterior sheathing board within a lightweight facade system. Rendered build-ups may use it as a render carrier board, plaster backing board, or exterior cement board for plaster.

fire-protection.title: Fire resistant cement board for walls
fire-protection.text: Used as a non-combustible cement board and fire protection board in the independently tested E 120 / EI 90 / EW 120 fire-rated wall system for commercial, public, and industrial buildings. Specifications should reference the tested system rather than a general fireproof wall panel claim.

wet-rooms.title: Moisture-resistant bathroom cement board
wet-rooms.text: Suitable as cement board for wet rooms, cement backer board, and tile backer board with Mapei Mapegum WPS or Schönox HA waterproofing systems. A waterproof cement board for bathroom use still requires the specified membrane and system installation.

commercial-buildings.title: Interior and exterior boards for commercial buildings
commercial-buildings.text: Documented uses of cement board for commercial buildings include offices, retail, hospitality, and mixed-use developments, with partition wall board, interior wall board, and exterior wall board applications.

steel-frame.title: Steel-frame and industrial wall systems
steel-frame.text: Cladding and partition solutions for warehouses, production facilities, and logistics centres. Terasun TSM can be specified as a steel frame wall board or cement board for steel framing at the documented 400 or 600 mm stud centres.

residential.title: Residential and prefabricated construction
residential.text: Documented uses of cement board for residential buildings include facades, wet rooms, multi-family housing, and timber-frame construction. Teams assessing lightweight cement board for modular construction or cement board for prefabricated houses should request application-specific technical guidance before specifying.

ce.q: Does Terasun TSM have CE marking?
ce.a: Yes. CE 1023-CPR-1565 P. The product complies with the EU Construction Products Regulation and carries CE marking for sale and use across the European Economic Area.

eta.q: Is there a European Technical Assessment (ETA)?
eta.a: Yes. ETA 24/0895 has been issued by a designated ETA body. It independently confirms the product's performance characteristics for its intended uses. Full ETA available for download.

epd.q: Is there an EPD (Environmental Product Declaration)?
epd.a: Yes. EPD-IES-0018268, published 2025-03-14, valid until 2029-03-14. ISO 14025 compliant. Declared unit: 1 m² at 12 mm, weight 9.96 kg/m². Supports LEED, BREEAM, and DGNB certification projects.

weight.q: What is the declared weight of the board?
weight.a: The declared weight is 9.96 kg/m² for the 12 mm × 1200 mm × 2400 mm board, as stated in EPD-IES-0018268.

fire.q: What fire resistance does the board achieve?
fire.a: The tested system configuration achieved E 120 / EI 90 / EW 120 under independent report FIRES-CR-284-25-AUPE. Use this verified system classification rather than treating 'fireproof cement board' as an absolute stand-alone product claim.

wetroom.q: Can Terasun TSM be used in wet rooms?
wetroom.a: Yes. Terasun TSM is a moisture-resistant cement board suitable as a wet-room and bathroom substrate with Mapei Mapegum WPS or Schönox HA waterproofing membranes. Always follow the waterproofing manufacturer's system requirements.

facade.q: Can the board be used for exterior facade cladding?
facade.a: Yes. Terasun TSM is suitable as cement board for facade systems (CBSS and CBMV) across European climate zones when installed according to the Terasun facade system guide.

asbestos.a: Yes. Terasun TSM is asbestos-free. Reinforcement is cellulose fiber. REACH/SVHC compliance confirmed — no substances of very high concern above 0.1% w/w.

moq.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
moq.a: The minimum order is one container (20 ft or 40 ft). Volume depends on thickness and size mix. Flexible arrangements possible for initial trial orders from new partners.

samples.q: Are samples available before placing an order?
samples.a: Yes. Sample boards available for technical evaluation and customer presentations. Shipping costs apply outside Finland.

leadtime.a: Approximately 10–14 weeks from order confirmation to delivery in Central Europe: production (3–5 weeks) + ocean freight (4–6 weeks) + customs clearance and inland transport.

origin.a: Terasun TSM boards are manufactured by Zhejiang Terasun Air Duct Co., Ltd. in China. Terasun Europe, based in Vantaa, Finland, acts as the Authorised European Representative and manages all European documentation, logistics, and commercial relationships.

whoIsTerasun.a: Terasun Europe is the Authorised European Representative of Zhejiang Terasun Air Duct Co., Ltd., headquartered in Vantaa, Finland. We manage all European documentation, distribution, and commercial relationships for Terasun TSM fiber cement boards.

authorisation.q: Is there an authorisation letter from the manufacturer?
authorisation.a: Yes. An authorisation letter confirming Terasun Europe as the Authorised European Representative is available for download. This document can be used in procurement, tendering, and specification processes.

distributor.q: Can I become a distributor in my country?
distributor.a: Yes — most European markets are open. Use the contact form to describe your distribution network, target market, and expected volumes. We respond within 2 business days.

openMarkets.q: Which countries are open for distribution?
openMarkets.a: Finland is our active market. All other EU and EEA countries are open, including Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, France, Poland, Czech Republic, Austria, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, and more.

studSpacing.a: The board is compatible with standard timber and steel frames at 400 mm or 600 mm centres. No proprietary wall panel system is required; follow the relevant installation guide.

training.q: Is technical training available for distributors?
training.a: Yes. Remote and in-person training for distributor sales and technical teams, covering product knowledge, system applications, certifications, and installation best practices.

publicProjects.q: Can Terasun TSM be used on public and infrastructure projects?
publicProjects.a: Yes. CE marking, ETA 24/0895, DoP, EPD, and fire test report provide the full documentation package required for specification on public projects and building authority submission across the EU.

cuttingTools.q: What cutting tools are needed for installation?
cuttingTools.a: Circular saw with a fiber cement blade, or score-and-snap for straight cuts. Pre-drill near edges. Full instructions in the Cutting & Fixing Guide available in the download centre.
